description: This file contains implementation of WebRTC audio processing helpers, including configuration, stream setup, and echo cancellation dump control, specific to the Chromium project.

methods.name: ConfigAutomaticGainControl
methods.description: Configures automatic gain control settings based on platform and user settings.

methods.name: CreateStreamConfig
methods.description: Creates a WebRTC stream configuration based on audio parameters.

methods.name: StartEchoCancellationDump
methods.description: Starts dumping echo cancellation data to a file for debugging.

methods.name: CreateWebRtcAudioProcessingModule
methods.description: Creates and configures a WebRTC audio processing module based on settings.
